root_cause.text: The function `handle_one_ule_extension()` uses an unvalidated index `htype` derived from network-controlled data (`ule_sndu_type & 0x00FF`) to access fixed-size arrays of 255 elements, allowing an out-of-bounds read when `htype` equals 255.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state that the index `htype` has a range of 0-255 but the arrays `ule_mandatory_ext_handlers[]` and `ule_optional_ext_handlers[]` are declared with 255 elements (valid indices 0-254), so an index of 255 causes an out-of-bounds read. The patch adds a bounds check: `if (htype >= ARRAY_SIZE(ule_mandatory_ext_handlers)) return -1;`.
